integrity: The finite census exhausts all 46656 profiles, cross-checks two Gale–Shapley implementations, verifies proposal counts from men-optimal partner ranks, and independently brute-force checks all perfect matchings for stability.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for the labeled three-by-three strict-preference stable-marriage market under independent uniform preferences. The one-round atom and marginal stable-matching counts are prior results; larger markets and asymptotic distributional claims are outside scope.
title: Exact proposal law for three-by-three Gale–Shapley under uniform preferences
